Pass 7 (2026-05-07): HIGH fixed in fix-mmap-cache-refcount-after-replace -- _MmapCache.release() looked up the cache entry by realpath, so a holder that acquired the OLD mmap before an os.replace and released it AFTER another caller had acquired the post-replace entry would decrement the new holder's refcount. Subsequent eviction (cache full, or another acquire) closed the still-in-use mmap, breaking reads with 'mmap closed or invalid'. Real exposure: any concurrent reader/writer pattern where to_geotiff replaces a file that another reader had just opened via open_geotiff with chunks= or via _FileSource. PR #1506 added stale-replacement detection but did not fix the refcount confusion across the pop. Fix: acquire returns an opaque entry token; release takes the token and decrements that exact entry, regardless of cache state. Orphaned (popped) entries close their fh+mmap when their own refcount hits zero. _FileSource updated to pass the token.
